failures.evidence: `docs/solutions/testing/a-pod-harness-moves-tmpdir-too-and-the-failure-mode-is-a-silent-kill-INFRA-44.md`:138-141's INFRA-221 note says 'that staging is still the step' of the bullet at :131-137, whose premise (:133) is 'No role container sets `TMPDIR`, so they default to `/tmp`'. The section the note names lists `TMPDIR` among 'the variables the runtime actually sets for you' (tools.md:87), and the code agrees: `roleEnvironment` sets `{Name: "TMPDIR", Value: scratchRoot + "/tmp"}` (packages/daemon/internal/runtime/sandbox/manifest.go:734). Observed in this role container: `echo $TMPDIR` -> `/legion/scratch/tmp`, and `df -h /tmp /legion/scratch/tmp` puts /tmp on the container's `/` and TMPDIR on the 49G `/legion` volume, with no export by anyone. The bullet was true when written (#2088 merged 2026-10-21 03:32Z) and went stale three hours later (#2085, 06:29Z, added the variable); this round's note re-endorses it four days after. A reader of the note is told to export by hand what the runtime already exports, on a premise that is false. Fix (one clause): the note says the runtime now sets `TMPDIR` onto the issue's volume (`roleEnvironment`), so the staging the bullet asks for is done for you and the export is needed only where something unsets it.
